================================================================================
Member-pointer function types: T (C::*)(Args...) in template args and using
================================================================================

struct X {};
template<typename T> struct TypeMarker {};

template<typename Return, typename Class, typename... Arguments>
constexpr size_t get_arity(TypeMarker<Return (Class::*)(Arguments...) const>)
{
    return sizeof...(Arguments) + 1;
}

TypeMarker<int (X::*)(int)> m;
using P = int (X::*)(int);

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    name: (type_identifier)
    body: (field_declaration_list))
  (template_declaration

      (type_parameter_declaration
        (type_identifier)))
    (struct_specifier

      body: (field_declaration_list)))
  (template_declaration
    parameters: (template_parameter_list

        (type_identifier))
      (type_parameter_declaration
        (type_identifier))
      (variadic_type_parameter_declaration

      type: (primitive_type)
      declarator: (function_declarator

        parameters: (parameter_list
          (parameter_declaration
            type: (template_type
              name: (type_identifier)
              arguments: (template_argument_list
                (type_descriptor
                  type: (type_identifier)

                      (variadic_parameter_declaration

                        declarator: (variadic_declarator)))
                    (type_qualifier))))))))

        (return_statement

              scope: (namespace_identifier))

              (parameter_declaration
                type: (primitive_type)))))))
    declarator: (identifier))
  (alias_declaration
    name: (type_identifier)
    type: (type_descriptor
